item.name: 00 Onboarding pipeline (automated)
item.description: Self-contained, scripted onboarding journey: new user, authentication, tenant creation, employee onboarding, tenant boundaries, integrated-app onboarding, activation, event processing, and final verification. Needs the seeded fixtures (tests/requestly/seed-onboarding.mjs) and the variables in the collection. Captured values (IDs, the one-time app credential, session cookie) are runtime variables and are not saved.
